verdict.rationale: Gide documents strong cross-border capability generally — 11 global offices, international fundraising/M&A work, and international employee share scheme support — but there is no specific documentation of venture-specific cross-border mechanics like redomiciliations/flips or multi-jurisdiction financing structuring for investors. Missing for 10: explicit mention of redomiciliation/flip transactions, dedicated cross-border investor structuring content, and case examples of multi-jurisdiction financings.
